mechanism: neurogenesis of non-pluripotent C2C12 myoblast inducer

hypothesis.mechanism: neurogenesis of non-pluripotent C2C12 myoblast inducer
context_requirements: C2C12 myoblast lineage or equivalent non-pluripotent myogenic context
absence of strong oncogenic or epithelial lineage dominance
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression in any of the nine human cell lines at 6 h or 24 h
Induction of neural lineage markers or neurogenesis-associated genes in the panel
Shared transcriptional signature with known neurogenesis inducers in these lines

changes: No gene-level claims were present to correct; empty proximal/late lists are consistent with the stated mechanism being untestable in the nine human lines.
Kept line_response as 'none' because the mechanism is defined for C2C12 myoblasts and no human-line-specific response can be justified.
Kept falsifiers but noted they are not mechanism-specific; no evidence citations were supplied, so none were retained.
